t: Real Research Today: Lightning Harvest Stations
title: Real Research Today: Lightning Harvest Stations
definition: Today's documented research behind Lightning Harvest Stations.
description:
The road to Lightning Harvest Stations is already being paved. Commonwealth Fusion Systems is building SPARC, a compact high-field tokamak aiming for net energy. Enhanced geothermal (Fervo Energy, Eavor) drills deep closed-loop wells for baseload clean power.

The US National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition (net energy gain) in December 2022. Together these programs form the triggered lightning foundation that Lightning Harvest Stations will build on — the station logistics results, the surge handling methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as station logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Lightning Harvest Stations
definition: Estimates Lightning Harvest Stations readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Lightning Harvest Stations components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a station hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Lightning Harvest Stations Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Lightning Harvest Stations operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Lightning Harvest Stations installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 51691 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where triggered lightning monitoring, station logistics redundancy, or surge handling maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Lightning Harvest Stations Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Lightning Harvest Stations: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Lightning Harvest Stations — stations capturing lightning strikes for power.

Phase 1 — Prove (triggered lightning): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (station logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (surge handling): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (tower arrays): station hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and storm regions-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
